tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Resolvent estimate] 1. ch8:8.7\group ch08-generalized-solutions If $\sigma \notin \Sigma $ and $u\in W^{1,2}(\Omega )$ solves $L_\sigma u=g+D_if^i$ with $u=\varphi $ on $\partial \Omega $, then \begin{equation} \| u\| _{W^{1,2}(\Omega )} \leq C\left(\| g\| _2+\sum _i\| f^i\| _2 +\| \varphi \| _{W^{1,2}(\Omega )}\right), \tag {8.16} \end{equation} where $C$ depends only on $L$, $\sigma $, and $\Omega $.
Proof

\sketch The Green operator $G_\sigma =L_\sigma ^{-1}:\Hcal ^*\to \Hcal $ is bounded.

□
